---
title: OAuth 2 Authorization Code Login with PKCE
---
sequenceDiagram
autonumber
actor U as User
participant B as Browser
participant S as Our SPA
participant A as Auth server
participant API as Our API
U->>B: Click "Log in"
B->>S: Login clicked
activate S
Note over S: Make code_verifier, code_challenge = SHA256(verifier), state
S->>B: Redirect to /authorize with code_challenge, state
deactivate S
B->>A: GET /authorize (client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, state)
activate A
A-->>B: Login and consent page
U->>B: Enter credentials, consent
B->>A: POST credentials
A-->>B: 302 to redirect_uri?code&state
deactivate A
B->>S: Load callback with code, state
activate S
S->>S: Check state matches
S->>A: POST /token (code, code_verifier, redirect_uri)
activate A
Note over A: Verify SHA256(code_verifier) == code_challenge
alt Verifier matches
A-->>S: access_token, id_token, refresh_token
else Mismatch or expired code
A-->>S: 400 invalid_grant
end
deactivate A
S->>API: GET /me with Bearer access_token
activate API
API->>A: Fetch JWKS (cached)
A-->>API: Signing keys
Note over API: Validate signature, audience, expiry
API-->>S: 200 user profile
deactivate API
S-->>B: Render signed-in app
deactivate S
